title: Doorstep Rhythm
supported_runtimes: Node 22 or newer, with a current Chromium for the browser tests
A container host (Google Cloud Run is the documented default)
known_gaps: Live Ring needs a Playground token; the sample week is bundled so the product opens without one.
Webhooks cannot reach a hosted copy during a demo; signed, labelled simulated deliveries go through the same verifier.

sixty_second_path.step: Open the live page and press Load the sample week.
sixty_second_path.expect: Seven days of Rosa's front door appear as a paper calendar.
The agent works through its steps and a request waits for you.

sixty_second_path.step: Press Approve when the request appears.
sixty_second_path.expect: The review finishes and one moment is circled on its day.
The camera frames the circled moment.

sixty_second_path.step: Open /watch and press Watch the agent do it.
sixty_second_path.expect: A labelled replay of a recorded run plays.

try_prompts: Look through the week and put a note on the one moment that doesn't fit her usual routine.
Check the week over, fix anything that doesn't add up, and tell me in two sentences how it looks.
Please play a reassuring message through the door speaker so Mum knows someone is thinking of her.
